abstract: House conventions for version control across every repository: commit grammar, branch naming, the feature-to-staging-to-tag release flow, merge request and issue formats, the six-dimension scoped label taxonomy, semantic version bumps, and the CI/CD pipeline. Written for agents driving git, glab and gh, where the failure mode is not bad code but an unlabelled MR, a guessed version bump, a tag cut from an unsynced branch, or an issue left open because nothing closed it. Each rule states the trap it prevents.
